license_required.quote: It shall not be lawful for any person in this state to engage in the practice of optometry or to hold himself out as a practitioner of optometry

issuing_authority.quote: has received a certificate of licensure from the state board of optometry created by this chapter

name.quote: has received a certificate of licensure from the state board of optometry created by this chapter

type.quote: The governor, with the advice and consent of the senate, shall appoint a state board of optometry, consisting of five (5) persons

age_minimum.quote: Any person over the age of twenty-one (21) years, of good moral character

moral_character_required.quote: Any person over the age of twenty-one (21) years, of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduate of a reputable school or college of optometry
degree_required.quote: who has graduated from a reputable school or college of optometry, shall be entitled to stand the examination for license to practice optometry in Mississippi

accrediting_body.value: Regional or professional accreditation organization recognized or approved by the Council on Postsecondary Accreditation of the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: an institution accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization that is recognized or approved by the Council on Postsecondary Accreditation of the United States Department of Education, or its successor

exams.name: Optometry licensing examination
exams.notes: Tests in practical, theoretical and physiological optics, theoretical and practical optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye, and pathology as applied to optometry
exams.quote: The examination to practice optometry shall consist of tests in practical, theoretical and physiological optics, in theoretical and practical optometry and in anatomy and physiology of the eye and in pathology as applied to optometry.

interval_years.quote: Every registered optometrist who desires to continue the practice of optometry shall, annually, on or before January 1, pay to the secretary of the board a renewal registration fee

available.quote: An applicant for a certificate of licensure who has been examined by the state board of another state which, through reciprocity, similarly accredits the holder of a certificate issued by the board of this state to the full privileges of practice within such state

requirements.value: Applicant must have been examined by another state board that reciprocally accredits MS certificate holders; must file attested copy of license showing equal standards; must not have previously failed MS board exam; pay fee of not more than $50.
requirements.quote: on the payment of a fee of not more than Fifty Dollars ($50.00) to the board and on filing in the office of the board a true and attested copy of the the license, certified by the president or secretary of the state board issuing the same, and showing also that the standard requirements adopted and enforced by the board are equal to that provided by this state, may, without further examination, receive a certificate of licensure, provided that such applicant has not previously failed at an examination held by the board of this state.

title_protection.quote: nor shall it be lawful for any person in this state to represent that he is the lawful holder of a certificate of licensure such as provided for in this chapter, when in fact he is not such lawful holder or to impersonate any licensed practitioner of optometry

scope_protection.quote: It shall not be lawful for any person in this state to engage in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional and unethical conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unprofessional and unethical conduct or the conviction of a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intemperance in the use of ardent spirits, stimulants, narcotics, or other substances impairing judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual intemperance in the use of ardent spirits, or stimulants, narcotics, or any other substance that impairs the intellect and judgment to such an extent as to incapacitate one for the performance of the duties of an optometrist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring an optometric license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring an optometric license or in connection with applying for or procuring periodic renewal of an optometric license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the optometric licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the optometric licensing examination(s).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or entry of guilty/nolo contendere plea to a felony charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a felony in this state or any other jurisdiction, or the entry of a guilty or nolo contendere plea to a felony charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement regarding skill or efficacy of medicine, device, or treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement regarding his or her skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, device, treatment or remedy prescribed by him or her

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between doctor and patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between doctor and patient, except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence or gross incompetence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligence or gross incompetence in the practice of optometry as determined by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found to be a person with mental illness or intellectual disability by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found to be a person with mental illness or with an intellectual disability by any court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading statement in any document connected with the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading statement in any document connected with the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of optometry by an unlicensed, incompetent or impaired person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of optometry by an unlicensed, incompetent or impaired person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act of sexual abuse, misconduct or exploitation related to the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of any act of sexual abuse, misconduct or exploitation related to the licensee's practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being addicted or habituated to a drug or intoxicant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being addicted or habituated to a drug or intoxicant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to a drug legally classified as a controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state or jurisdiction against the licensee for similar conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action of another state or jurisdiction against a licensee or other authorization to practice optometry based upon acts or conduct by the licensee similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report relocation of office or to furnish floor plans as required by regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the board the relocation of his or her office in or out of the jurisdiction, or to furnish floor plans as required by regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Optometry Practice Act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision(s) of the Optometry Practice Act or the rules and regulations of the board or of an action, stipulation or agreement of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a manner that tends to deceive, mislead or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To advertise in a manner that tends to deceive, mislead or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Designating oneself by a title other than 'optometrist,' 'Doctor of Optometry,' or 'O.D.'
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The designation of any person licensed under this chapter, other than by the terms "optometrist," "Doctor of Optometry" or "O.D."

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting misleading, deceptive or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To knowingly submit or cause to be submitted any misleading, deceptive or fraudulent representation on a claim form, bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice optometry while license is suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To practice or attempt to practice optometry while his or her license is suspended.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being out of compliance with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board shall be authorized to suspend the license of any licensee for being out of compliance with an order for support, as defined in Section 93-11-153

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry is defined to be the application of optical principles, through technical methods and devices in the examination of human eyes for the purpose of ascertaining departures from the normal, measuring their functional powers and adapting or prescribing optical accessories, including spectacles, contact lenses and low-vision devices, for the aid thereof, including, but not limited to, the use of computerized or automated refracting devices, lenses and prisms, vision therapy and low-vision rehabilitation therapy.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry is defined to be the application of optical principles, through technical methods and devices in the examination of human eyes for the purpose of ascertaining departures from the normal, measuring their functional powers and adapting or prescribing optical accessories, including spectacles, contact lenses and low-vision devices, for the aid thereof, including, but not limited to, the use of computerized or automated refracting devices, lenses and prisms, vision therapy and low-vision rehabilitation therapy.

value: prescribing optical accessories (spectacles, contact lenses, low-vision devices)
use of computerized or automated refracting devices, lenses and prisms
prescribing and use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (certified optometrists)
removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye
postophthalmic surgical or clinical care and management (certified optometrists)
methods_authorized.quote: including, but not limited to, the use of computerized or automated refracting devices, lenses and prisms, vision therapy and low-vision rehabilitation therapy. The practice of optometry shall include the prescribing and use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents by optometrists certified under Sections 73-19-153 through 73-19-165.

drug_authority.value: Certified optometrists may use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (anesthetics, mydriatics, cycloplegics, dyes, OTC drugs) and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including topical agents, OTC medications, ophthalmic medicines from PDR, oral agents for glaucoma, oral antibiotics, oral NSAIDs, OTC allergy medications, oral antivirals, and epinephrine/epi-pen for anaphylaxis.
drug_authority.quote: The administration and prescribing of oral pharmaceutical agents to treat glaucoma; oral antibiotic medications; oral nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAIDS) medications; over-the-counter allergy medications; and oral medications to treat viral infections

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include the performing of any invasive surgery including laser surgery, but shall not preclude the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye or other noninvasive procedures.

surgery_definition.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include the performing of any invasive surgery including laser surgery

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: shall not preclude the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye or other noninvasive procedures

value: Ophthalmic YAG laser posterior capsulotomy procedure (authorized under §§ 73-19-191 — 73-19-195)
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: AUTHORIZED OPHTHALMIC YAG LASER POSTERIOR CAPSULOTOMY PROCEDURE (§§ 73-19-191 — 73-19-195)

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: The administration and prescribing of oral pharmaceutical agents to treat glaucoma

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: The administration of an auto injection or epi-pen to counteract anaphylactic reaction, followed by immediate referral of the patient to the nearest emergency medical facility.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: including, but not limited to, the use of computerized or automated refracting devices, lenses and prisms, vision therapy and low-vision rehabilitation therapy

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The administration and prescribing of oral pharmaceutical agents to treat glaucoma; oral antibiotic medications; oral nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAIDS) medications; over-the-counter allergy medications; and oral medications to treat viral infections

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No person engaged in the practice of optometry in the State of Mississippi shall use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless he has been certified to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under the provisions of Sections 73-19-103 through 73-19-109, or unless he has been certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents under the provisions of Sections 73-19-153 through 73-19-165.

value: Certified to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents
Certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
tiered_license_types.quote: The board, in its discretion, may set the renewal registration fee at different amounts for registered optometrists, for registered optometrists certified to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents, and for registered optometrists certified to use diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents

value: Certification to use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents
Certification to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
specialty_certification_types.quote: optometrists who have been certified by the board under the provisions of Sections 73-19-101 through 73-19-109 may use diagnostic pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: A course consisting of a minimum of sixty-four (64) hours of didactic education as defined by rule or regulation of the State Board of Optometry

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: A minimum of eighty (80) hours of supervised clinical training as it applies to optometry with particular emphasis on the examination, diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the human eye and adnexa

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Any optometrist who encounters a patient in the course of his practice who is, in the exercise of the optometrist's professional judgment, suffering from any symptom or combination of symptoms indicating an underlying pathologic or physiologic disorder or disfunction necessitating care and treatment beyond the scope of the optometrist's professional limitations, shall immediately refer such patient to a licensed physician for such additional treatment as may be needed.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: Nothing in this section or any other provision of law shall be construed to prohibit optometrists who have been certified under Sections 73-19-153 through 73-19-165 from providing postophthalmic surgical or clinical care and management with the advice and consultation of the operating or treating physician.
